messages:
harper: Postmortem follow-up for the DNS throttle -> routing churn -> TLS retry cascade. Keeping this concise: owners, ETAs, blockers. Reply with "ack" + ETA.

Action items:
1) registrar backoff map: implement per-registrar cooldowns and token-bucket to avoid rapid reconciles (owner: neil) - ETA: 2026-03-30
2) route reconciler linearization: single-writer queue + idempotent apply to avoid transient dual-paths (owner: harper) - ETA: 2026-04-05
3) LB/client retry guard: add per-peer concurrent handshake cap + full-jitter backoff and global soft-stop on amplification (owner: ana) - ETA: 2026-03-31
4) synthetic probe: injection that simulates registrar 429 + region pair flips, alert on amplification_ratio > 1.7 (owner: ana) - ETA: 2026-03-28
5) runbook & comms: short mitigation playbook + customer advisory for passthrough configs (owner: product@redwood) - ETA: 2026-04-02

neil: ack. I'll add a registrar policy file and token bucket on reconcile calls. Will include per-cloud defaults and tests.

harper: ack. I'll prototype a single-writer queue and a migration to reapply routes in canonical order. Will gate behind feature flag route/linearize.

ana: ack (typo, should be ana). Plan: cap concurrent handshakes to 8 by default, backoff base=40ms, cap=1.5s, full jitter. Also add a runtime soft-stop when amplification_ratio > 1.2 for 2m.

ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket NET-5389 assigned to harper, neil, ana, product@redwood. First sync scheduled 2026-03-29 15:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: tag=registrar-backoff.v1 region=us-west-2 queued_ts=2912345700. Dashboard: /dashboards/net-regressions.

neil: question: should registrar backoff be configurable per-tenant? some customers have registrar quirks.

harper: yes, make per-registrar defaults with per-tenant override. add docs.

ana: note: will coordinate client lib bump and add compatibility note for passthrough LBs so customers don't get double-capped.

harper: blocker: need registrar testbed creds to validate probe. @infra can you grant?

ops-bot: infra team notified to grant testbed access.

harper: thanks everyone. please update this thread when PRs are open or ETAs slip. If you can't meet ETA, ping me and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:
